substantial. However, the Nepalese authorities demonstrated during the preparation of

DPC1 and DPC2 that they are able to take critical decisions in an uncertain political

environment (such as the closure of distressed financial institutions, the decision to proceed

with in-depth diagnostics, and the approval of the recapitalization plans for the NBL and

RBB and subsequently making large capital injections into the two banks). Implementation

risks for DPC2 are mitigated through demonstrated commitment at the highest levels of

the government and bureaucracy and through close alignment with the IMF and DFID, as

well as through an extended preparation phase with continued policy dialogue, which has
